010

Questions, answered.

Everything about using aegi as a pregnancy tracker, baby tracker, and private journal.

Is aegi a free baby tracker?

Yes. aegi is free during early access. You can log feeds, diapers, sleep, growth, and milestones, and keep a private journal — no subscription required to get started.

Can aegi track my pregnancy week by week?

Yes. aegi is a week-by-week pregnancy tracker with size comparisons, a due-date countdown, and gentle logging for weight, mood, blood pressure, water, and medications.

What can I log with the newborn and infant tracker?

You can log feeds (formula, expressed, or breastfeeding), diaper changes (wet and dirty), sleep, and growth — most entries take a single tap, with a 24-hour timeline of every event.

Does aegi have a contraction timer and kick counter?

Yes. aegi includes a contraction timer that tracks duration and interval, plus a kick counter for daily fetal movement. aegi is not a medical device — always consult your care provider.

Is my data private, and does aegi work offline?

Your entries stay private to your family and the app works offline, so you can log a feed or write a journal entry anytime — even without a connection.

Is aegi available on iPhone and Android?

aegi launches on iOS in spring 2026 with Android to follow in summer. Join early access to be among the first to use the pregnancy and baby tracker.
